notes.title: The ASTRO SAGA New Chapter, "RANDOMAX" will be released on January 16!
notes.content:

[b]Ride or drive the turbulent waves of luck toward victory![/b]
A novel rogue-lite vertical scrolling Shmup that puts your resourcefulness to the test!

A vast and random arsenal of misdelivered heavy weapons enter into your possession.
Find the most effective way to utilize them and turn the tides of battle in your favor!

notes.title: "Graze Counter GM" WANTS you to play dangerously!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UdcxDrR-5Dw;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]A refreshing and highly re-playable bullet hell style shooter that WANTS you to play dangerously![/b]

"Graze" past enemy bullets to charge your "Graze Counter", then unleash it upon your enemies as a highly deadly attack! 
Ride the razor's edge of life and death in this high-risk high-reward danger oriented arcade style shooting game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486440/

notes.title: Heavy weight Run 'n Gun mech shooter, "MECHBLAZE" is comming on Nov. 6th!!
notes.content:

An inferno roars over a destroyed secret military base.

Machine guns mow down wave after wave of advancing steel.
Pile Bunkers send deadly lances piercing through giant foes.
Then, from the flaming rubble...[b]an invincible super robot is reborn! [/b]

Super Mechs born of advanced science and modern weaponry battle in [b]heavy weight run-and-gun mech shooter!![/b]

notes.title: Please Vote for ZANGEKI WARP - Now On Steam Greenlight!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that ASTRO PORT’s latest & greatest shooting game - [i]ZANGEKI WARP[/i] – is now up on Steam Greenlight! Check out game details below and please visit the Greenlight page and vote [b]YES[/b] to help bring this awesome game to Steam!!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=787972790
[i]ZANGEKI WARP[/i] takes place just after the events of [i]STEEL STRIDER[/i]. In this game, you take control of the hyperdimensional fighter craft ‘ZanFighter’ and use its advanced warp functions to defeat an army of space beasts controlled by an evil scientist! 

[i]ZANGEKI WARP[/i]’s warp capabilities bring a new twist to the style of [i]Gradius[/i], [i]R-Type[/i], and [i]X-Multiply[/i], and are the key to overcoming thrilling stages filled with traps and obstacles that would be impossible in regular shooting games. Use the warp functions to stop time, instantly warp through enemy fire and obstacles, and even to destroy enemies.

Greenlight approval permitting, we plan to release [i]ZANGEKI WARP[/i] on both Windows and Linux in January 2017, priced only $5.99, and it will include Steam-based achievements, online trading cards, and online leaderboards.

On behalf of everyone at Nyu Media and ASTRO PORT, [b][i]THANK YOU!!
